node: the line between two .box elements in the sketch frame

id.comment: fold key — latest edge per id wins. Convention: '<from>><to>:<label>' so a relabel re-emits in place and parallel arrows stay distinct

label.comment: the verb-phrase (olog reading: 'renders as', 'is folded from') — optional; a bare arrow is legal

edge.comment: the link-gesture act: drag from a node's label, drop on another node. Sketch first content: the floor olog's arrows.

derives.composition: UNDESIGNED: if from-type composes with to-type, a derived edge exists — the category question. When a user earns it, the composition law is declared HERE, in edge lexicons, not in code

link.guard: from and to are present node ids

system.tick: shared 2s poll; edge layer redraws on render()

render.element: #edgelay (SVG overlay in the playground, pointer-events: none)
render.template: line between node centers, verb-phrase label at midpoint; rubber-band line while the gesture is in flight
